title: Evas Tanztutorial Basse danse Teil 1 - Grundlagen, Schritte

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher introduces historical background and posture before breaking down each step of the basse danse in detail. She demonstrates movements slowly and repeats them with counting instructions.

lesson_structure.note: Welcome and introduction to the basse danse

common_mistakes: Der linke Fuß bleibt hinten und wird nicht nachgezogen

steps_taught.name: Pas simples
steps_taught.description: Simple forward steps moving towards a goal

steps_taught.name: Pas doubles
steps_taught.description: Double steps lasting twice as long as a pas simple

steps_taught.name: Référance
steps_taught.description: Bow or reverence to start or end

what_works: Clear verbal breakdown of each step
Repetition of movements in different directions

quotes.text: Die Basse danse ist ein höfischer Tanz
Mit den Pas simples, den einfachen Schritten, bewege ich mich auf ein Ziel zu.
Er dauert doppelt so lang wie ein Pas simple.

evidence_segments.observation: The teacher stands sideways and explains the movement of the feet for Pas simples.

extraction.distinctive_method: Focuses on historical context and posture before teaching fundamental dance steps of the 15th century.
